newsitem.title: USA: Network Peripherals CFO Cole to resign.
newsitem.headline: Network Peripherals CFO Cole to resign.

text.p: Network Peripherals Inc said Friday its Chief Financial Officer Truman Cole plans to leave the company within the next few months.
The company said it is searching for a replacement and that Cole will stay to ensure a smooth transition of his responsibilities.

Cole joined Network Peripherals in early 1994 and coordinated the company's initial public offering and secondary offering. The company said Cole "has indicated a desire to work with a smaller firm," possibly a pre-public company.

Network Peripherals also said it has appointed Fred Kiremidjian as senior vice president of worldwide operations in charge of NPI's global engineering and manufacturing activities. Kiremidjian will work closely with newly appointed Chief Technology Officer Oliver Szu.
